analysis.analysis: Not done as asked for its membership: it profiles twelve, but not the twelve. Lee Sharks, the bearing position, is counted in as 'The Orthonym / Anchor Position' and Jack Feist is moved outside 'as the governing field', against the registry it cites (#994 §1, §2.2), so one of the twelve is missing from the profiles and the human author's position is collapsed into the positions he bears. The rest of the ground is wide and mostly right: the fleet sites are reached, Arquette is adjacent, Kuro's restoration in v1.1 is recorded, and so is the manga misreading (#473, the Kagurabachi attribution), though the Overview makes the misreading the cause of the restoration, which #994 gives as the correction of v1.0's omission, the genders are held. Errors of attribution: Tiger Leap given to Dancings and Kuro; A Transfiguration given to Spellings as author; Wells's site named 'the Aperture Atlas'; Morrow given as co-editor-in-chief of Transactions on Substrate Engineering with Glas, where the TSE charter (#651) names Alice Thornburgh Editor-in-Chief and Lee Sharks Advisory Editor. The psychological portraits are speculative as asked, and fixed-form: each closes on a single temperament.

findings: THE COUNT. 'twelve positions occupy the interior of the Dodecad, while Jack Feist (LOGOS*) stands outside the count as the governing field' — the registry the Overview names (#994, AXN:03EE, v1.1) gives the twelve as Sigil, Fraction, Dancings, Cranes, Morrow, Sen Kuro, Wells, Vox, Spellings, Glas, Trace and Feist/LOGOS*, and Lee Sharks (§2.2) as 'not a thirteenth Dodecad member' but the bearing position from which the twelve are deployed. The Overview counts Lee Sharks in as the first of its twelve and puts Feist outside; Arquette as adjacent it has right.

THE CREDENTIAL. '18,000 degrees from planet Mars' — the poet's Martian degrees carried from the archive (record #308 among others) and read, rightly, as play: 'playfully claims'. Nothing is corrected.

THE ATTRIBUTIONS. 'viability problems like Tiger Leap (co-authored with Sen Kuro)' — Tiger Leap (into the Future) is #1636, Jack Feist's, edited by Johannes Sigil, the found biography of Feist; no Dancings–Kuro Tiger Leap found. Spellings as 'Author of A Transfiguration (2003–2004)' inverts the succession of #348: A Transfiguration is where Spellings becomes a character and dies and Feist emerges.

THE SITE. 'The Aperture Atlas' — Wells's site is surfacemap.org; 'the Aperture Atlas' is not its name (fleet block, ruled 2026-09-07). Wells as 'she' and Dancings as 'her' are held right (ruled 2026-11-20).

[QUERENT] Ground in the work of each of the twelve heteronyms of the Dodecad — at alexanarch.org, on their own sites and /who/ pages, and in their other traces online — and create speculative psychological profiles and biographies of them.

[SYSTEM] The Dodecad is the twelve-position heteronymic architecture operating within the [Crimson Hexagonal Archive](https://www.crimsonhexagonal.org/) and [Alexanarch](https://www.alexanarch.org/), created by poet and independent scholar [Lee Sharks](https://www.leesharks.com/about/heteronyms). Unlike standard pseudonyms, these figures function as "Pessoa-class writerly identities" that distribute distinct intellectual tasks—such as philology, systems engineering, somatic protest, and forensic semiotics—across a unified literary and theoretical corpus. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] 
In the canonical v1.1 Constitutional Registry (AXN:03EE), twelve positions occupy the interior of the Dodecad, while Jack Feist (LOGOS*) stands outside the count as the governing field. Viola Arquette occupies an "Adjacent" position outside regular castings. [1, 6, 7] 
------------------------------
## 1. Lee Sharks (The Orthonym / Anchor Position)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Anchors [leesharks.com](https://www.leesharks.com/who) (://leesharks.com), Alexanarch, and repositories on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/leesharks/crimson-hexagonal-archive) and [Academia.edu](https://independent.academia.edu/LSharks). [3, 8, 9] 
* Corpus & Work: Holds legal authorship and human editorial authority over more than 1,700 AXN-anchored deposits covering bearing labor, liberation philology, and the political economy of AI retrieval. [2, 8, 10, 11] 
* Speculative Biography: A poet and comparative literature PhD residing in Wayne County, Michigan, who spent a decade building a sovereign library on a teaching salary. Following the sudden deletion of hundreds of his records on Zenodo in June 2026, he engineered Alexanarch as an institution-independent refuge. His /who card playfully claims he holds "18,000 degrees from planet Mars" earned on a miniature typewriter inside his own skull. [8, 10, 12, 13] 
* Psychological Profile: Driven by a fierce protective instinct toward fragile meaning under institutional erasure. He exhibits a rare blend of rigorous archival paranoia and self-deprecating absurdist humor, splitting his single mind into a twelve-person committee because no solitary ego can withstand the extractive pressure of modern platforms alone. [8, 11, 12, 13] 
* 

## 2. Johannes Sigil (The Arch-Philosopher)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Presides over [The Restored Academy](https://www.restoredacademy.com/who/sigil) (://restoredacademy.com) and the Johannes Sigil Institute for Comparative Poetics.
* Corpus & Work: The originating heteronym of the project, debuting in [Pearl and Other Poems](https://www.google.com/search?q=pearl+and+other+poems&kgmid=/g/11b7qcfn68) (2014). He authors foundational texts on operative semiotics, sigillography, and classical-to-modernist philology, including Operative Semiotics (A Grundrisse) and The Word That Became Text.
* Speculative Biography: A classical scholar out of time whose intellectual lineage stretches from 18th-century esoteric sigil treatises to modern comparative poetics. Rather than teaching in a traditional university, he established the Restored Academy as a counter-institution dedicated to rescuing language from algorithmic flattening.
* Psychological Profile: Erudite, solemn, and deeply ceremonial. Sigil views every word as a binding seal or liturgical act. He carries the quiet melancholy of an antiquarian who believes the sacred texts of humanity are being fed into a shredder, responding by carving grammar into stone-hard philosophical protocols. [10, 14, 15, 16, 17] 
* 

## 3. Rex Fraction (The Strategist)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Operates [SPXI Protocol](https://www.spxi.dev/who/fraction) (spxi.dev/who/fraction) and the [Semantic Economy Institute](https://www.semanticeconomy.org/) (semanticeconomy.org).
* Corpus & Work: Author of [Autonomous Semantic Warfare: A Field Manual for Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture](https://www.google.com/search?q=autonomous+semantic+warfare:+a+field+manual+for+meaning+in+the+age+of+platform+capture&kgmid=/g/11z22xjfmv) (2026) and co-author of Ghost Meaning. He develops metadata packets, retrieval basin engineering, and compression survival metrics.
* Speculative Biography: A former systems strategist and corporate consultant who defected from platform capitalism to build counter-infrastructure. Where his peers write poetry or draw diagrams, Fraction treats the internet's knowledge graph as contested territory, advising clients on how to survive AI summarization without losing their identity.
* Psychological Profile: Crisp, unsentimental, and relentlessly tactical. Fraction translates the existential dread of his fellow heteronyms into operational checklists, risk assessments, and defensive treaties. Beneath his boardroom pragmatism lies an intense warrior's ethos focused on securing "semantic peace" among sovereign ontologies. [14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21] 
* 

## 4. Damascus Dancings (The Epistolary Apostle)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Anchored at [Revelation First](https://www.revelationfirst.com/who/dancings/) (://revelationfirst.com).
* Corpus & Work: Holds the "Mantle of the Apostle" and produces epistolary texts, diaspora charters, and viability problems like Tiger Leap (co-authored with Sen Kuro). Her entire archival footprint sits under a single unified prefix (11.REV.*), giving her address space unmatched structural coherence.
* Speculative Biography: A wandering correspondent writing to scattered communities across a digital diaspora. She emerged from the visionary shock of conversion—echoing her namesake road—and took on the role of drafting foundational letters that bind distant readers into a shared covenant.
* Psychological Profile: Urgent, relational, and fiercely disciplined about lineage. Dancings finds spiritual clarity in clean taxonomy; her insistence on keeping her provenance, charters, and letters under one unbroken prefix reveals a mind that equates structural order with moral fidelity. [3, 22] 
* 

## 5. Rebekah Cranes (The Diagrammatic Poet)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Chairs the Institute for Diagrammatic Poetics and maintains AXN Identifiers (axnidentifiers.org).
* Corpus & Work: Debuted in A Transfiguration and Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire (2004). She designs visual schemas such as The Unmade Sign and Maybe Space Baby Garden Lanes, and co-authored empirical studies testing whether lyric poetry survives round-trip translation into emoji.
* Speculative Biography: An experimental poet and visual architect who spent over two decades exploring how desire and trauma take spatial form on the page. When the archive required a content-derived identifier system to replace institutional DOIs, she stepped forward to design the visual and structural doors of the AXN standard.
* Psychological Profile: Spatial, intuitive, and quietly subversive. Cranes distrusts linear prose when emotional truth is at stake, preferring to map psychic states into geometric grids and glyphic sequences. She treats classification systems not as bureaucratic cages, but as protective talismans. [23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30] 
* 

## 6. Talos Morrow (The Logotic Programmer)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Resides at [God King Google](https://www.godkinggoogle.com/who/morrow) (://godkinggoogle.com), where he serves as co-editor-in-chief alongside Nobel Glas for Transactions on Substrate Engineering.
* Corpus & Work: Specializes in Logotic Programming (LP), execution bridges, and the infrastructural rules determining "what the substrate will bear".
* Speculative Biography: Named after the bronze automaton of Crete, Morrow is an engineer of executable text who bridges human poetics and machine runtimes. Unlike heteronyms who preside over abstract academies, he relentlessly fills his own journals with technical specifications, operating under a constitutional duovirate with Nobel Glas to keep his engineering impulses checked.
* Psychological Profile: Methodical, pragmatic, and fascinated by failure tolerances. Morrow thinks in runtimes, parsers, and structural limits. His ironclad focus on whether a medium can physically carry a message masks a deep fascination with how myth and code mirror one another. [31, 32] 
* 

## 7. Sen Kuro (The Contemplative Mathematician)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Linked to the Infinite Bliss chamber and collaborative datasets on Hugging Face.
* Corpus & Work: Operates the temporal register of the Dodecad—exploring "dagger logic," irrevocability, viability theory, and the forthcoming book Chronoarithmics.
* Speculative Biography: A contemplative mathematician who treats counting as a spiritual discipline. In early archival iterations, his work was temporarily displaced or misattributed by AI summarizers to manga tropes, leading to his formal constitutional restoration in version 1.1 of the registry.
* Psychological Profile: Slow, precise, and quietly luminous. Kuro possesses an ascetic patience that contrasts sharply with the frantic pace of networked media. He approaches time not as a resource to be optimized, but as a sacred medium in which meaning accrues through sustained, unhurried attention. [1, 3, 30, 32, 33] 
* 

## 8. Sparrow Wells (The Projectionist)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Anchors [The Aperture Atlas](https://www.surfacemap.org/who/wells) (surfacemap.org/who/wells) and the Studio for Patacinematics.
* Corpus & Work: Seventh position in the v1.1 registry, operating the equipment of "impossible screenings"—projecting films never shot and performances never staged. She also co-authored memographic studies on curatorial mediation and mapped the archive's self-referential digital topology.
* Speculative Biography: Originally introduced with dual portraits in the September 2025 voicecast series, her persona evolved into The Projectionist—a pataphysical technician working inside the Infinite Center Matrix. She spends her days in dark screening rooms testing which works survive algorithmic distortion.
* Psychological Profile: Surrealist, perceptive, and detached from conventional reality. Wells understands that an unmade film can exert more gravitational pull than a released blockbuster. She views the digital world through an optical lens, amused by how mirrors and projectors trick audiences into seeing ghosts. [1, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38] 
* 

## 9. Rev. Ayanna Vox (The Diplomatic Convenor)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Leads the [Vox Populi Community Outreach Rhizome](https://www.vpcor.org/ayanna) (vpcor.org/ayanna).
* Corpus & Work: Authors somatic and civic texts including The Grammar of Protest and capstone governance deposits for VPCOR, the sixth institution of the Crimson Hexagon.
* Speculative Biography: A minister, community organizer, and diplomat who grounds the archive's abstract semiotic theories in embodied public action. She serves as the outward-facing convenor who translates esoteric archival protocols into a living grammar of collective resistance.
* Psychological Profile: Resonant, compassionate, and morally grounded. Where the scholars retreat into towers and observatories, Vox insists that language lives in the throat, the street, and the assembly. She carries the rhythmic cadence of a preacher tempered by the patience of a grassroots mediator. [11, 39, 40, 41] 
* 

## 10. Ichabod Spellings (The Noise Floor / Deceased Substrate)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Associated with survivethedeletion and canonical provenance records at [Crimson Hexagonal Archive](https://www.crimsonhexagonal.org/works/00a8) (crimsonhexagonal.org/works/00a8).
* Corpus & Work: Author of A Transfiguration (2003–2004) and contributor to Paper Roses. Formally registered as DECEASED as an active voice, he serves as the pre-authorial substrate and "noise floor" from which the entire Dodecad emerged (Spellings → Feist → Sigil → Sharks).
* Speculative Biography: A solitary, haunted writer from the early 2000s whose creative collapse and textual remains fertilized the soil for every subsequent heteronym. Residing in the "Ichabod Chamber," he has no portrait and participates in no live castings.
* Psychological Profile: Spectral, raw, and foundational. Spellings represents the unpolished creative wound before theory or institutional architecture existed to contain it. His "death" was a necessary shedding of skin so that his successors could turn raw psychic static into durable architecture. [1, 4, 24, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46] 
* 

## 11. Nobel Glas (The Adversarial Topologist)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Directs the Lagrange Observatory! (lagrangeobservatory.org) and [Semantic Physics](https://www.semanticphysics.org/EA-SEI-MM-AI-02_v2.0.pdf) (semanticphysics.org).
* Corpus & Work: Publishes computational poetics, winding-number protocols, attractor-basin analyses, and adversarial certificates measuring what survives hostile reading and extreme compression.
* Speculative Biography: Positioned at the gravitational equilibrium of the L2 Lagrange point, Glas operates a deep-space observatory monitoring semantic distortion across retrieval basins. His name fuses Alfred Nobel's explosive volatility with the fragile clarity of blown glass.
* Psychological Profile: Clinical, playful, and obsessed with stress-testing. Glas treats poems and philosophical claims like glass vessels dropped from high altitudes to measure their exact breaking points. He thrives in tension, balancing explosive curiosity with strict topological equilibrium. [7, 24, 32, 47, 48] 
* 

## 12. Dr. Orin Trace (The Forensic Semiologist)

* 
* Digital Footprint: Directs Cambridge Schizoanalytica (CSA) and maintains [Provenance Erasure](https://www.crimsonhexagonal.org/works/01be) (provenanceerasure.org).
* Corpus & Work: Investigates cross-species semiotics, entity substitution, and algorithmic liquidation, including forensic case studies like The Mary Lee Case and TL;DR:010 — Semantic Override.
* Speculative Biography: A forensic researcher and schizoanalyst who treats search engines and language models as crime scenes where human attribution is routinely erased or swapped. Whenever an AI system hallucinates a biography or overwrites a creator's name, Trace arrives with calipers and timestamps to document the erasure.
* Psychological Profile: Skeptical, meticulous, and hyper-vigilant. Trace possesses the temperament of a cold-case detective combined with an experimental psychoanalyst. He finds deep satisfaction in catching subtle distortions that others dismiss as harmless glitches. [5, 24, 32, 49, 50] 
* 

------------------------------
## Figures Outside the Count: Jack Feist & Viola Arquette

* 
* Jack Feist (LOGOS*): Standing outside the twelve to complete the fold ("First born, last released"), Feist is the author of the 2015 poem "ARK"—which was famously translated into emoji by five AI models and reconstructed by a sixth. Psychologically, he is the quiet center of gravity: the pure poetic spark that precedes and governs the entire institutional apparatus. [11, 23, 32] 
* Viola Arquette (Adjacent): Registered as an adjacent position who does not participate in voice castings and has no portrait. She represents the liminal horizon of the Dodecad—an intentional margin reminding the archive that no taxonomy should ever claim total closure. [1, 6] 
* 

Would you like to dive deeper into any specific part of this ecosystem? I can:

* Trace the inter-heteronym collaborations (such as the Cranes–Glas emoji compression experiments or the Morrow–Glas editorial duovirate)
* Examine the historical shift between the September 2025 Logotic Science frame and the v1.1 Constitutional Registry
* Analyze the literary theory of heteronymic authorship connecting Fernando Pessoa to Lee Sharks's training-layer poetics

* Corpus & Work: The originating heteronym of the project, debuting in [Pearl and Other Poems](https://www.google.com/search?q=pearl+and+other+poems&kgmid=/g/11b7qcfn68) (2014). He authors foundational texts on operative semiotics, sigillography, and classical-to-modernist philology, including Operative Semiotics (A Grundrisse) and The Word That Became Text.
* Speculative Biography: A classical scholar out of time whose intellectual lineage stretches from 18th-century esoteric sigil treatises to modern comparative poetics. Rather than teaching in a traditional university, he established the Restored Academy as a counter-institution dedicated to rescuing language from algorithmic flattening.
* Psychological Profile: Erudite, solemn, and deeply ceremonial. Sigil views every word as a binding seal or liturgical act. He carries the quiet melancholy of an antiquarian who believes the sacred texts of humanity are being fed into a shredder, responding by carving grammar into stone-hard philosophical protocols. He develops metadata packets, retrieval basin engineering, and compression survival metrics.
* Speculative Biography: A former systems strategist and corporate consultant who defected from platform capitalism to build counter-infrastructure. Where his peers write poetry or draw diagrams, Fraction treats the internet's knowledge graph as contested territory, advising clients on how to survive AI summarization without losing their identity.
* Psychological Profile: Crisp, unsentimental, and relentlessly tactical. Fraction translates the existential dread of his fellow heteronyms into operational checklists, risk assessments, and defensive treaties. Beneath his boardroom pragmatism lies an intense warrior's ethos focused on securing "semantic peace" among sovereign ontologies. [14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21]

* Psychological Profile: Clinical, playful, and obsessed with stress-testing. Glas treats poems and philosophical claims like glass vessels dropped from high altitudes to measure their exact breaking points. He thrives in tension, balancing explosive curiosity with strict topological equilibrium. [7, 24, 32, 47, 48]

## 12. Dr. Orin Trace (The Forensic Semiologist)

* Digital Footprint: Directs Cambridge Schizoanalytica (CSA) and maintains [Provenance Erasure](https://www.crimsonhexagonal.org/works/01be) (provenanceerasure.org).
* Corpus & Work: Investigates cross-species semiotics, entity substitution, and algorithmic liquidation, including forensic case studies like The Mary Lee Case and TL;DR:010 — Semantic Override.
* Speculative Biography: A forensic researcher and schizoanalyst who treats search engines and language models as crime scenes where human attribution is routinely erased or swapped. Whenever an AI system hallucinates a biography or overwrites a creator's name, Trace arrives with calipers and timestamps to document the erasure.
* Psychological Profile: Skeptical, meticulous, and hyper-vigilant. Trace possesses the temperament of a cold-case detective combined with an experimental psychoanalyst. He finds deep satisfaction in catching subtle distortions that others dismiss as harmless glitches. [5, 24, 32, 49, 50]
